name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for the Sticks app (AI employees: team, task board, confirm cards)

sdks.name: agent_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of agent/dart/install.py at agent@798de2da; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: A Sticks app's home IS the team page (the Sticks, their task board and the confirm cards), so agent_sdk provides the entry page through its `app_type.sticks` flavor block (selected by .rokct/config/app_type = sticks; the customer, driver, launcher, manager, polaris and supacharge shells keep it a plain non-home SDK). Screens call only the api.sticks.* gateway cmds in /mnt/project-files/sticks/sticks-call-contract.md; no AI loop runs behind them yet.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/dart/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: auth_sdk

sdks.name: comms_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of comms/dart/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Push notifications: a Stick that needs you (an open confirm card) is the one event worth a push.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/dart/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: App telemetry: events flow through base_sdk's TelemetryClient.track gateway cmd, with telemetry_sdk owning delivery policy via the TelemetryClient.configure transport seam.
